42:class Operator(QExpr):
43:    """Base class for non-commuting quantum operators.
44:
45:    An operator maps between quantum states [1]_. In quantum mechanics,
46:    observables (including, but not limited to, measured physical values) are
47:    represented as Hermitian operators [2]_.
48:
49:    Parameters
50:    ==========
51:
52:    args : tuple
53:        The list of numbers or parameters that uniquely specify the
54:        operator. For time-dependent operators, this will include the time.
55:
56:    Examples
57:    ========
58:
59:    Create an operator and examine its attributes::
60:
61:        >>> from sympy.physics.quantum import Operator
62:        >>> from sympy import I
63:        >>> A = Operator('A')
64:        >>> A
65:        A
66:        >>> A.hilbert_space
67:        H
68:        >>> A.label
69:        (A,)
70:        >>> A.is_commutative
71:        False
72:
73:    Create another operator and do some arithmetic operations::
74:
75:        >>> B = Operator('B')
76:        >>> C = 2*A*A + I*B
77:        >>> C

79:

82:        >>> A.is_commutative
83:        False
84:        >>> B.is_commutative

90:

27:
28:    Examples
29:    ========
30:
31:    Daggering various quantum objects:
32:
33:        >>> from sympy.physics.quantum.dagger import Dagger
34:        >>> from sympy.physics.quantum.state import Ket, Bra
35:        >>> from sympy.physics.quantum.operator import Operator
36:        >>> Dagger(Ket('psi'))
37:        <psi|
38:        >>> Dagger(Bra('phi'))
39:        |phi>
40:        >>> Dagger(Operator('A'))

44:
45:        >>> from sympy.physics.quantum import InnerProduct, OuterProduct
46:        >>> Dagger(InnerProduct(Bra('a'), Ket('b')))
47:        <b|a>
48:        >>> Dagger(OuterProduct(Ket('a'), Bra('b')))
49:        |b><a|

51:    Powers, sums and products::
52:
53:        >>> A = Operator('A')
54:        >>> B = Operator('B')
55:        >>> Dagger(A*B)
